notes.title: The latest in the "Atelier" series, “Atelier Resleriana” is now free-to-play!
notes.notes:
Adventure, Alchemy, Everyday

KOEI TECMO GAMES and Akatsuki Games present the latest title in the Atelier series!
A story of the two protagonists Resna and Valeria, and the simple yet profound game system of gathering, synthesis, and battle. Plus, encounter many characters from past Atelier games.

For new starters only! Two of the highest rated ★3 characters (Rorona + another character) are guaranteed!

Begin your alchemy adventure by playing this free-to-play game now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2594920/
